scope: Read-only minimal generic proposal; no core/source/database edits and no model requests.
scope_diff:
@@ _ordinary_transmission, after exact LNG-export channel and before regional background
 if role=='lng_export' and region in {'unspecified','region_only'}:
     return ['expectation','longer_term'],'global_lng_export_expectations'
+if kind=='future_supply' and region in {'region_only','unspecified'}:
+    return ['expectation','longer_term'],'conditional_regional_future_supply_expectations'
 if region=='region_only':return ['background'],'regional_background'

rendering_contract.zh: 区域未来供给的条件预期；欧洲/全球LNG市场联系仍待评估
rendering_contract.en: conditional regional future-supply expectations; European/global-LNG market linkage remains to be assessed

condition_contract: For this new conditional channel, use the existing regional_link_required scenario condition rather than implying that an already established market transmission merely becomes stronger.
weight_prompt_one_general_sentence: For conditional_regional_future_supply_expectations, evaluate market linkage from the supplied source evidence; scope eligibility does not establish European/global-LNG physical supply, and weight=0 remains valid when the connection or present-window materiality is unsupported.
unchanged: Fact type, source quote, selected evidence IDs, metadata role and model classification output are never repaired or silently replaced.
No company-specific patterns, role string replacements, direction overrides, mandatory nonzero importance or label-distribution targets.
Exact lng_export receives the more precise global_lng_export_expectations channel.
Historical, corporate/technology, generic import-facility and region-only observed end-use/supply remain background.

expected_contrasts.facts: future supply project / upstream / region_only / nonhistorical
future supply project / lng_export / region_only or unspecified / nonhistorical
observed US raw-gas supply increase / upstream / region_only / nonhistorical
US regional end-use demand increase / end_use / region_only / nonhistorical
corporate contract, technology or generic import facility, any role/region
future upstream supply project / europe / nonhistorical

acceptance_not_required: The next real model run need not have any particular nonzero importance or up/down/flat label; semantic source facts, available conditional channel, model-chosen importance and final derived label must agree.
